clips.title: The story
paras: At Thunder Bluff, Tal tends the Horde's chief wind rider roost above the plains of Mulgore. He sends seasoned wyverns carrying travelers across Kalimdor.

Tal tends the wind rider roost on Thunder Bluff's central mesa, linking the tauren capital with the rest of the Horde. He cares for the loyal wind riders, or wyverns, keeping them healthy and well-fed for long journeys across Kalimdor. From the roost, he sends messengers to Camp Taurajo and scouts across the Barrens to Orgrimmar. The flights keep the towering mesa city in touch with its allies.
